summary: Breach Ring ilvl 82 with three T1 attack flats (one self-fractured behind a desecrated blocker), two resistance suffixes and 60% Attack quality.

steps: Annul + Chaos a Breach Ring ilvl 82 until a T1 attack flat (physical least preferred)
Omen of Greater Exaltation + Greater Exalted Orb for two more mods, add a desecrated mod as fracture blocker
Fracturing Orb, 1 in 3 to fracture the T1 flat
Strip the other mods, Chaos spam ~200-300 for a second T1 flat
Dextral Exaltation + Exalt a placeholder suffix, then Dextral Crystallisation + Essence of the Breach (+20% max quality, eats the suffix)
Lightning catalyst to 60%, Catalysing + Greater Exaltation + Perfect Exalt for two resistance suffixes
Reaver catalyst back to 60%, Omen of Whittling + (Greater) Chaos to remove the quality mod and fix weak suffixes
Desecrate the last prefix with Abyssal Echoes; Omen of Light + new bone until a T1 attack flat
Catalyst counts assume ~1% quality per catalyst (the planner's own rate): lightning to 60% once (twice if the slam misses), Reaver back to 60%

Not costed (counts not stated): the first T1 flat roll on the clean ring, the blocker bone, the whittle chaos and the final collarbone + Omen of Light loop ('hundreds of divs if unlucky'); 200 div is his minimum bankroll, not a measured total
He finished with all-res + T2 dexterity + T1 intelligence (lightning res whittled away, 'I would have preferred a resistance', 5:22-5:39), so one resistance suffix is the target

market.source: creator estimate at upload (kPBToE_G5t8 6:37-6:46: 'anywhere between 200 to maybe 600'), not a trade check
